item.title: Gambit 1.1
item.description:
# Gambit 1.1
Released November 5, 2026.
## Pictures, in the agent
- **Screenshots reach the model that can read them.** An agent asked to look at a page takes a screenshot, and that picture goes to the model as an image — but only if the model accepts images. Sent to one that does not, the request was refused outright and the whole turn was lost, including the page text the model could still have used. That is fixed, and a text-only model is now told a screenshot was taken and pointed at the tools that read the page as text instead. - **The picker says which models see images.** Rows that accept pictures carry a "sees images" mark, so the choice is visible where the choice is made rather than found by hitting an error. - **A refusal reads honestly.** An image sent to a model that cannot take one used to report "the gateway doesn't know that model", which sends you to check your API key. It now says the model cannot read images and points at the picker.
## Updates, fixed
- **The app can see its own updates.** Version 1.0 advertised itself to Sparkle as "1.0" while the installed bundle reported a build timestamp — numerically far larger — so every copy already on disk considered itself newer than the feed and would never have offered the release. The bundle version is the release version now, which is what the 0.1.x line always did. - **About, Settings and ⌘K read the real feed.** They still pointed at the old update fetcher and showed "The update feed answered 404". All three now show Sparkle's state: the release waiting to install, the feed it came from, and Check now.
## Under the hood
- The About panel no longer credits the upstream project; this is Gambit's own application. - The build warns when the provisioning profile cannot run WebAuthn, instead of letting passkeys fail without a word.
## Notes for anyone on 0.1.x
The signing key for updates was rotated. A 0.1.x install will not accept this release's signature and needs one manual download — after that, updates work normally again.
